description: Inspect operational logs and endpoint telemetry; fix confirmed slow/failing endpoints and improve request/response contracts with focused validation.

acceptance_criteria: Measure and rank high-frequency or high-latency Hub paths from current source and runtime evidence; preserve baselines and distinguish synthetic results.

Integrate performance changes while preserving user modifications, durable job lifecycle, duplicate request identity rules, synchronous fast-path contracts, and RAG indexing progress/terminal behavior.

Admit Laya based on fresh measured available VRAM and conservative request size; valid reservation identity, reservation budget, or another resident model alone must not reject it. Preserve malformed/unknown telemetry fail-closed behavior and generation-bound leases.
Keep Laya lazy-loaded on first request, warm for 600 seconds after its latest completed request, and never unload or preempt another resident model.
Resume six-root RAG recovery and GPU measurement only after root identity and a verifiable runtime owner/window are established; never replay outcome_unknown jobs.
Run focused validation and diff checks; separate source/test evidence from live runtime evidence.
Measure current endpoint use, latency and errors; distinguish optional or specialized unobserved routes from applicable endpoints and fix only evidence-backed causes.
Collect Laya shadow data only for real root-bound Agent OS tasks and sessions; callers pass existing identity when available; no synthetic identity or authority relaxation.
Expose original preprocessing failure and failure-state recording error with bounded local diagnostics; fix source-confirmed preprocessing defects and preserve incremental caches.
When no live Hub action matches an operation, use the authorized native tool directly; after an advertised action fails, fallback only on terminal=true and retryable=false.
For model token/context limits, reduce optional context/output scope or fetch a smaller artifact and continue from deterministic evidence; never replay unchanged requests or accept partial output.
Restart Hub only after audit; report source, runtime and verification evidence separately.
